blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines aims to complete all 19 priority economic deliverables under its 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) chairmanship by year-end, building on the signing of a landmark regional digital economy agreement on Saturday. President Marcos said on Sunday these deliverables form part of the country’s efforts to strengthen regional connectivity
